overview: inspired by Syed Abdul Malik’s acclaimed bio-fiction novel, the film traces the life and legacy of Assam's first filmmaker - Jyoti Prasad Agarwala. Returning from Germany after studying filmmaking, Jyotiprasad aspires to make his debut film 'Joymoti' despite Assam’s lack of filmmaking infrastructure and his family’s opposition. The film also explores the women who shape his personal and creative life, including Miranda, Sili, Rachana, and his wife Devajani, while examining the personal sacrifices demanded by his unwavering devotion to art. As the freedom movement grows,  Jyoti Prasad turns to resistance, composing songs and living underground. His life ends early, but his vision endures through his art, ideals, and legacy.
title: Pilgrims of Beauty
